fullPassage: Cartilage is extremely important for the healthy functioning of a joint, especially if that joint bears weight, like your knee. This squeezing of joint fluid into and out of the cartilage helps it respond to the off-and-on pressure of walking without breaking under the pressure. The cartilage in your left knee then "drinks in" synovial fluid, in much the same way that a sponge soaks up liquid when put in water. When you take another step and transfer the weight back onto your left leg, much of the fluid squeezes out of the cartilage. Imagine for a moment that you’re looking into the inner workings of your left knee as you walk down the street. When you shift your weight from your left leg to your right, the pressure on your left knee is released.

det.analysis: ❌ False: 원문은 "shift your weight from your left leg to your right" → 왼쪽에서 오른쪽으로 옮길 때 풀림
det.tip: 방향 주의: from left to right → 왼쪽에서 오른쪽으로 옮길 때 왼쪽 압력 해소

questions.passage: Cartilage is extremely important for the healthy functioning of a joint, especially if that joint bears weight, like your knee. This squeezing of joint fluid into and out of the cartilage helps it respond to the off-and-on pressure of walking without breaking under the pressure. The cartilage in your left knee then "drinks in" synovial fluid, in much the same way that a sponge soaks up liquid when put in water. When you take another step and transfer the weight back onto your left leg, much of the fluid squeezes out of the cartilage. Imagine for a moment that you’re looking into the inner workings of your left knee as you walk down the street. When you shift your weight from your left leg to your right, the pressure on your left knee is released.
questions.stem:
다음 진술이 본문의 내용과 일치하면 True, 일치하지 않으면 False를 고르시오.

"The cartilage absorbs synovial fluid similarly to how a sponge absorbs water."

det.korean: "in much the same way that a sponge soaks up liquid when put in water" → 스펀지와 같은 방식으로 흡수 → True
det.analysis: ✅ True: sponge soaks up liquid = 스펀지가 물을 흡수하듯이
det.tip: 비유 파악: cartilage absorbs fluid ≈ sponge soaks up liquid
